text: （Upstream が 0.19.* 対応になってたんで neovim をリビルドするだけで良かった、って話でした）

お〜、 `brew uninstall neovim` からの `brew install neovim --HEAD` で一発で治りました！

そんな気がしてきました
neovim を rebuild すればいいっぽい？
<@U8996GYBF> さんが闘ってたから知ってるはず。

> Neovim itself is compatible with 0.18.3 and 0.19.3, it only requires a clean build and linking to the same tree-sitter version it was built with. The parsers must also be compatible. But I guess that with neovim/neovim#14076 0.19.3 will just be the pre-dominant version so that you no longer have to care about that (tree-sitter was trying to avoid ABI breaks in the past but it is still pre-1.0 software)
